#!/bin/bash
# Restore globally-installed agent skills from ~/.agents/.skill-lock.json.
#
# The skills CLI (vercel-labs/skills) does not yet support `npx skills install -g`
# from a lock file (issues #283 / #549), so we hand-roll restore here:
#   1. The lock file itself is chezmoi-managed via dot_agents/modify_dot_skill-lock.json.tmpl
#      (merger that preserves per-machine state).
#   2. This script reads the merged lock and, for any entry whose
#      ~/.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md is missing, runs
#      `npx skills add <source> -s <name> -g -y` to (re)install it.
#
# Trigger: changes to the merger script's $managed block (the source-of-truth list).
#   merger: {{ include "dot_agents/modify_dot_skill-lock.json.tmpl" | sha256sum }}
#
# Idempotent: a re-run with no missing skills is a no-op.
# See: docs/tools/agent-skills.md

set -eu
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"

info()    { printf '\033[0;34m[INFO]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
warn()    { printf '\033[1;33m[WARN]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
success() { printf '\033[0;32m[SUCCESS]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }

LOCK="$HOME/.agents/.skill-lock.json"

if [ ! -f "$LOCK" ]; then
  warn "Global lock file not found at $LOCK — skipping (chezmoi apply should create it)."
  exit 0
fi

if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  warn "jq not installed; cannot parse $LOCK — skipping. Run \`chezmoi apply\` again after the base ansible role finishes."
  exit 0
fi

if ! command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  warn "npx not installed; cannot restore global skills — skipping."
  exit 0
fi

# Collect names of skills declared in the lock that are missing on disk.
missing=()
while IFS=$'\t' read -r name source; do
  [ -z "$name" ] && continue
  if [ ! -f "$HOME/.agents/skills/$name/SKILL.md" ]; then
    missing+=("$name"$'\t'"$source")
  fi
done < <(jq -r '.skills | to_entries[] | "\(.key)\t\(.value.source)"' "$LOCK")

if [ ${#missing[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
  info "All globally-managed agent skills present; nothing to install."
  exit 0
fi

info "Restoring ${#missing[@]} missing global skill(s) via \`npx skills add ... -g\`"
for entry in "${missing[@]}"; do
  name="${entry%%$'\t'*}"
  source="${entry##*$'\t'}"
  info "  → $name (from $source)"
  # Note: -s <name> filters to one skill within multi-skill repos.
  # No -a flag → npx prompts auto-detect agents from $HOME/.<agent>/ presence.
  if npx -y skills@latest add "$source" -s "$name" -g -y >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    success "    installed $name"
  else
    warn "    failed to install $name (continuing)"
  fi
done

success "Global agent skills sync complete."
```

#!/bin/bash
# Restore project-scope agent skills declared in this chezmoi repo's
# ./skills-lock.json — but ONLY when this machine's chezmoi source dir IS the
# chezmoi repo itself (i.e. you're using this machine to edit the repo with an
# agent, not just consuming dotfiles from it).
#
# Why this script exists:
#   Global skills (`~/.agents/skills/`) are restored by
#   run_onchange_after_40_install_global_skills.sh.tmpl from the merged
#   ~/.agents/.skill-lock.json. That handles the "every machine" case.
#
#   Project skills (`./.agents/skills/` inside this repo) are different: they
#   only make sense when an agent is launched from the repo working tree to
#   edit the repo itself. Without this script, after a fresh `chezmoi init`
#   on a new machine you'd have to remember to manually run
#   `just bootstrap-skills` before agents could see project-scope skills.
#
# Trigger: changes to the project lock file's content.
#   skills-lock.json: {{ if (joinPath .chezmoi.sourceDir "skills-lock.json" | stat) }}{{ include (joinPath .chezmoi.sourceDir "skills-lock.json") | sha256sum }}{{ else }}absent{{ end }}
#
# Idempotent: `npx skills experimental_install` skips skills already present
# at ./.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
# See: docs/tools/agent-skills.md (Project scope section).

set -eu
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"

info()    { printf '\033[0;34m[INFO]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
warn()    { printf '\033[1;33m[WARN]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
success() { printf '\033[0;32m[SUCCESS]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }

SOURCE_DIR={{ .chezmoi.sourceDir | quote }}
LOCK="$SOURCE_DIR/skills-lock.json"

if [ ! -f "$LOCK" ]; then
  # Not editing the chezmoi repo from this machine — nothing to do.
  # (Most consumer machines clone via `chezmoi init` into ~/.local/share/chezmoi
  # which IS the repo, so they'll still hit the path below; this branch only
  # triggers for unusual setups where source dir ≠ repo root.)
  exit 0
fi

if ! command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  warn "npx not installed; cannot bootstrap project skills — skipping."
  warn "Run \`just bootstrap-skills\` later from $SOURCE_DIR after Node is available."
  exit 0
fi

cd "$SOURCE_DIR"

# Fast-path check: if every skill named in the lock already has a SKILL.md,
# don't even invoke npx (saves ~3-5s per `chezmoi apply`).
if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  all_present=true
  while IFS= read -r name; do
    [ -z "$name" ] && continue
    if [ ! -f "./.agents/skills/$name/SKILL.md" ]; then
      all_present=false
      break
    fi
  done < <(jq -r '.skills | keys[]' "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null)

  if [ "$all_present" = "true" ]; then
    info "All project-scope agent skills present at ./.agents/skills/; nothing to install."
    exit 0
  fi
fi

info "Bootstrapping project-scope agent skills from $LOCK"
if npx -y skills@latest experimental_install >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  success "Project agent skills sync complete."
else
  warn "npx skills experimental_install failed; run \`just bootstrap-skills\` manually to retry."
  exit 0  # don't fail the whole `chezmoi apply` over a non-critical bootstrap
fi
```

_**Agent (gpt-5.5 2026-04-24 07:34:42Z)**_

我的判斷：選 **2，只改新的那個加 `repo_`，舊的先不要動**。

理由：

- `run_onchange_after_` 是正確的，不該改成 `run_onchange_`。這些腳本都依賴 dotfiles / lock files / PATH 先就位。
- 這次新增的腳本語意確實不同：不是「全機器都需要的 global dotfiles setup」，而是「這個 chezmoi repo working tree 自己要用的 agent skills」。叫 `repo_bootstrap_project_skills` 或 `repo_bootstrap_agent_skills` 會比較清楚。
- 但把現有 5 個腳本全部 rename 成 `global_*` 會讓 chezmoi 視為新 run script，下一次 apply 很可能全部重跑一次，包括 ansible / brew。功能上可接受，但為了純命名不值得。
- `project` 這個詞有點模糊；在這個 repo 裡我會偏好 `repo_`，因為它不是「任何專案」的 project skills，而是「dotfiles repo 本身」的 project-scope skills。

我會建議命名成：

```text
run_onchange_after_45_repo_bootstrap_project_skills.sh.tmpl
```

或更短一點：

```text
run_onchange_after_45_repo_agent_skills.sh.tmpl
```

如果之後真的想做命名整理，再另開一個小 PR / commit 一次性 rename 全部，並在 commit message 明講「會觸發一次 onchange scripts 重跑」。目前這個改動我會避免擴大 scope。

_**Agent (gpt-5.5 2026-04-24 07:36:01Z)**_

對，**本質上是同一套 run script 機制**，只是放的位置不同。

`.chezmoiscripts/` 是 chezmoi source root 底下的一個特殊目錄：

```text
.chezmoiscripts/
  run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl
  run_once_before_00_bootstrap.sh.tmpl
```

裡面的檔案仍然要叫 `run_...`、`run_onchange_...`、`run_once_...`，也一樣支援 `before_` / `after_` / `.tmpl` / hash state。官方說法是：`.chezmoiscripts/` 裡的 scripts 會「像一般 scripts 一樣執行」，但不會在 target state 建出對應的目錄。來源：[chezmoi docs](https://www.chezmoi.io/reference/special-directories/chezmoiscripts/)。

差別主要是整理性：

```text
# 目前這種
run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl
run_onchange_after_30_brew_bundle.sh.tmpl

# 等價地可搬成
.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl
.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_30_brew_bundle.sh.tmpl
```

我對這個 repo 的建議：

- **新腳本可以放 `.chezmoiscripts/`**，repo root 會乾淨很多。
- **舊腳本先不要搬**，除非你接受下一次 apply 可能重新觸發一輪。尤其 `run_onchange_` 的 state 跟 entry path/內容有關；搬位置屬於 entry 變更，實務上要當成可能重跑。
- 如果要搬，適合做成一個明確的 cleanup commit，commit message 寫清楚「move run scripts into `.chezmoiscripts/`; expect one-time rerun」。

所以它不是另一種「state 清除」功能；你貼的 `chezmoi state delete-bucket ...` 是手動清掉 `run_onchange_` / `run_once_` 的執行紀錄。`.chezmoiscripts/` 只是 script 的收納目錄。
